about_the_game:
Main Story

After years of relentless effort, the protagonist finally achieves their lifelong dream. However, upon realizing this dream, they are overcome with a deep sense of emptiness and numbness. One day, while drowning their sorrows in alcohol, they come across a mysterious girl at the train station...

Gameplay

As the president of a software company, the protagonist is responsible for managing and operating the business. From software development plans to various employee affairs, every aspect is personally overseen by the protagonist.

Players are not only responsible for advancing the game's main storyline but can also freely explore various management and interactive gameplay elements to create a unique gaming experience.

Players take on the role of a company founder, responsible for operating and developing a software development company. By researching new software, recruiting and training employees, and optimizing budget management, they can help the company grow and enhance its market competitiveness. Players must allocate resources wisely, formulate development strategies, and ensure the company's steady progress.

The game features a shop where players can purchase various items. Using these items strategically can effectively advance the game.

Additionally, the game incorporates heartwarming interactions between the protagonist and his daughter. Players can arrange time to spend with her and participate in her growth journey. Different choices will influence the depth of their father-daughter relationship and may even alter the course of the story.

Players must find a balance between career and family, managing their company while maintaining a strong bond with their daughter, ultimately leading to different game endings.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows7 64Bit
  • Processor: Intel Core™i3-2130
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA or AMD graphics card with more than 2GB of VRAM
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 3 GB available space
  • Sound Card: Compatible with Windows audio devices
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows10 64Bit
  • Processor: Intel Core™ i5-3570
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA or AMD graphics card with more than 4GB of VRAM
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 3 GB available space
  • Sound Card: Compatible with Windows audio devices
